ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 15, 2021 approximately 10:00 a.m. There are currently 10 reserved seats for Gies College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 21, 2022 at approximately 10:00 a.m. Any exchange students outside of Gies College of Business that register will be removed from the course.
